worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.summary: Temporarily level both bodies' actual armour and armour toughness: the thicker side drops, the thinner side rises, all in the same world armour units. Pokémon raw Defence/Sp. Def and ability stages are left alone, and damage that explicitly ignores armour still bypasses it. Enemies and allies are both valid.
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.use.0: Raise your thin armour to the foe's thickness
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.use.1: Shave the foe's thick armour down to yours
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.use.2: Hand your thick armour to an ally that needs it
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.description: Average the armour and armour toughness both sides currently carry with a target within %1$s blocks, held for %2$s; a clear line is required.
Allies and enemies are both valid. Neither side may already carry this split window; a dimension already equal on both sides has nothing to split.

Only the armour and toughness that actually pass through the native armour calculation are read; raw Defence/Sp. Def growth and ability stages are untouched. This change is removed when the effect ends or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP to split, then %3$s seconds to recover and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.growth.0: At level %1$s the split reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.guardsplit.growth.1: At level %1$s the split reaches %2$s blocks and the window lasts %3$s seconds.
The companion only splits when the threat is within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases the gap down.

The foe's actual armour and toughness combined must reach this multiple of yours, and sharing to an ally requires you to exceed it by the same multiple. Higher is pickier and only splits across a clear gap.
On: it leaves its station under a hold order to split. Off: it only casts when the target is already in reach.
On: it may average its surplus armour onto an ally to armour a fragile partner. Off: it only shaves a foe's thick armour.
